name: ExoWork Onboarding
description: Get comfortable with ExoWork by completing a small project setup

phases.name: Getting Oriented
phases.description: Familiarize yourself with the workspace and checklist

steps.name: Check off this task
steps.description: Click the circle to the left — this is how you track progress on any checklist

steps.name: Browse the stages below
steps.description: Click on the stage header above 'Getting Oriented' to collapse or expand it

steps.name: Upload a sample document(s)
steps.description: Upload any file (agent can read Text, PDF, Images, screenshot, etc.)

steps.name: Summarize the uploaded file(s)
steps.description: On many of the tasks, agents will help you... click on the button to see how
steps.command: Some of the checklist items Look at the file(s) user has uploaded so far, look at time stamps, read the files, and give a quick short of types & content of the files.

phases.name: Working with the Agent
phases.description: Use the agent to make real changes to files in this project

steps.name: Create a meeting notes template
steps.description: Ask the agent to create a reusable meeting notes file for you
steps.command: Create a file called 'meeting-notes-template.md' with sections for Date, Attendees, Agenda, Discussion, and Action Items.

steps.name: Review and approve the file change
steps.description: The agent needs your permission before creating or modifying files — review the change and approve it

steps.name: Customize the template to your needs
steps.description: Tell the agent what to change — e.g. 'Add a Decisions section' or 'Remove the Agenda section'
steps.command: The user wants to customize the meeting notes template. Help them make changes based on their feedback.

steps.name: Decline a change you don't want
steps.description: When the agent proposes a change, click Deny to reject it — the agent will ask what you'd prefer instead

steps.name: Ask about an existing file
steps.description: Type @ in the chat to reference a file, then ask a question about it — e.g. '@meeting-notes-template.md how could I improve this?'

steps.name: Share a screenshot with the agent
steps.description: Paste or drag a screenshot into the chat — useful for showing the agent an error, a design, or something you want to discuss

steps.name: Have the agent plan before acting
steps.description: Ask the agent to organize your project files — it will propose a plan for you to review before making changes
steps.command: Review the files in this project and propose a plan to organize them into a clean folder structure. Present the plan before making any changes.

steps.name: Explore approval modes
steps.description: Try switching between Ask-first, Auto-approve, and Plan-only in the permissions bar to see how each mode works

phases.name: Managing Files Directly
phases.description: Use the file browser to view and edit files yourself

steps.name: Browse your project files
steps.description: Open the file browser in the sidebar to see everything in this project

steps.name: Edit a file by hand
steps.description: Click on a file to open it, make a small change, and save — not everything needs the agent

steps.name: Rename or move a file
steps.description: Right-click a file in the browser to see available actions — try renaming one
